vamp-chords.hears: The Rhodes/piano vamp: one soft chord on beat 2 of every bar, B-D-F# then A-C#-F# (Gmaj7 and Dmaj7 without their bass), from the first sound to the theme, and again in the interlude. Slow, even, quiet (v 40-75).
vamp-chords.rule: pack clusters on beat 2 (+-0.14 s) in 0-69.2 and 138.4-159.2 s with >= 2 notes in midi 45-80 and loudest >= 40; lowest, highest and loudest of each

chord-echoes.hears: The delay on the intro vamp (not in the interlude): 2-4 quieter repeats of each chord's keys, about 0.16 s apart, fading (v 20-55). A soft flutter after every chord, never a new event of its own.
chord-echoes.rule: after each vamp-chords chord, pack notes in 0.1-0.95 s on the chord's own keys and softer than it; the loudest of each 40 ms cluster

tick-loop.hears: A bright tick-and-chime figure, not a melody: three quick strokes in triplets on beat 3 and a landing on the downbeat, every bar, the same each time (written by the piano model as A5-Eb7 clusters; mostly transient: its Eb, C and Ab are partials). Enters 13.9 s, stays to 69 s, back 138.5-204 s (in D under the tune, whose attacks it leaves out).
tick-loop.rule: pack clusters in 13.8-69.2 and 138.4-204.2 s with a note >= Ab5 on beat 3 or later or within 0.07 s of the downbeat, except attacks of theme-a/theme-b; the loudest note of each

soft-bass.hears: A faint low pulse on the downbeats, D2 and G2 in turn (Satie's bass, very soft, v 30-67; short as written, under 0.2 s except in the interlude): from 15.6 s, and the interlude's G2/D2 at about 0.6 s each.
soft-bass.rule: pack notes below midi 50 in 15-69.2 and 138.4-159.2 s within 0.15 s of a downbeat

low-all.hears: Every bass note in one set: the soft downbeat pulse of the vamp, the band's oom, and the groove's bass from the audio. For one low-register thread through the whole piece.

high-strokes.hears: The bright octave strokes on beat 2 in A2: A5+A6 at 28.28 s (with the cymbals' entrance), then A6, Eb7, C#7 and F#7 (43.85 s, v91) over the vamp chord, v 75-96, most bars to 49 s, a last one at 61.2 s. The loudest thing before the band.
high-strokes.rule: pack notes >= A5 with v >= 75 on beat 2 (+-0.12 s) in 27.7-69.2 s, every note of the attack

ride.hears: The ride cymbal: on the beats from 28.3 s, through the theme, the interlude's last bars and the second theme (159.8 s on every beat), and the groove's eighths. The steadiest pulse of the piece. MIDI = GM drum key (51/53/59), not a pitch.
ride.rule: YourMT3 Drums rows with key 51/53/59; end t+0.12; velocity from the hit's band level (p10 -> 45, p90 -> 105)

hats.hears: Hi-hat, tambourine and shaker strokes (YourMT3's guesses), scattered: a handful at 28-69 s, a cluster at 120-135 s, a few at the end. MIDI = GM drum key (42/44/46/54/69/70), not a pitch.
hats.rule: YourMT3 Drums rows with key 42/44/46/54/69/70; end t+0.12; velocity from the hit's band level (p10 -> 45, p90 -> 105)

snare.hears: The snare/backbeat: brushed strokes under the theme (from the pickup at 67.8 s), the groove's snare from 207.1 s. MIDI = GM drum key (37/38/39/40), not a pitch.
snare.rule: YourMT3 Drums rows with key 37/38/39/40; end t+0.12; velocity from the hit's band level (p10 -> 45, p90 -> 105)

toms.hears: Toms: the fill at 207.4-207.5 s, the rolling tom run 211.2-212.9 s, then tom figures through the groove (223-282 s), and a few under the theme's cadence (131.5-135 s). MIDI = GM drum key (41/43/45/47/48/50), not a pitch.
toms.rule: YourMT3 Drums rows with key 41/43/45/47/48/50; end t+0.12; velocity from the hit's band level (p10 -> 45, p90 -> 105)

snare-pickup.hears: The snare pickup into the theme: four strokes 67.79-68.62 s, the drums announcing the band.

pah-chords.hears: The band's chord on beat 2 of every bar ("pah"): Satie's B-D-F# / A-C#-F# blocks, held about 1.1 s, louder than in the vamp (v 60-99). One attack per bar.
pah-chords.rule: pack clusters on beat 2 (+-0.12 s) in 69.2-135.0 and 159.2-204.2 s with >= 3 notes in midi 47-80; lowest, highest and loudest of each

kick.hears: The kick drum. A few under the theme (69.8-133 s, about one a bar), then the breakbeat's kick from 207.7 s, about 2 a second, to 285.6 s. MIDI = GM drum key (35/36), not a pitch.
kick.rule: YourMT3 Drums rows with key 35/36; end t+0.12; velocity from the hit's band level (p10 -> 45, p90 -> 105)

bass.hears: The band's bass on beat 1 of every bar ("oom"): D2 and G2 in turn under the first phrase, then a pedal on D2 and the walk B1-E2-C3-A2 of the second phrase; held 0.5-1.7 s, v 55-99. Ends on the D2 of each final chord.
bass.rule: pack notes below midi 50 in 69.2-135.0 and 159.2-205 s, held >= 0.3 s

crash.hears: Crash/china cymbals: on the melody's entrances (76.7, 77.9, 78.5, 80.2, 81.3, 88.3 s ...) and the fill at 207.7 s. Few (18), YourMT3's guess of the kind. MIDI = GM drum key (49/52/55/57), not a pitch.
crash.rule: YourMT3 Drums rows with key 49/52/55/57; end t+0.12; velocity from the hit's band level (p10 -> 45, p90 -> 105)

theme-a.hears: Satie's melody, first time, in octaves over the band: F#5 A6 | G6 F#6 C#6 | B5 C#6 D6 | A5 ... (77.3 s), the phrase again from 90.0 s, the second phrase from 103.9 s climbing F6-G6-A6 (114.2 s) and falling to the cadence. Long notes (0.5-1.7 s), v 60-107 (the falling ends of phrases are soft): the singing line.
theme-a.rule: voiced-out pack notes in 76.6-133.2 s: B4-B6, not Eb/Ab (tick partials), on a beat (+-0.1 s), held >= 0.28 s (or >= 0.15 s at v >= 85: short loud pickups), v >= 60 and within 6 of their attack's loudest; the upper of an octave pair

theme-a-p1.hears: Phrase 1 of theme-a (bars 44-47, four bars, about 6.9 s): F#5 A6 | G6 F#6 C#6 | B5 C#6 D6 | A5 (F#5): the famous opening.

melody-all.hears: Every sung line in one set: theme-a, theme-b and the lead-descent (the solo left out). For one melody clip that runs through the piece.

a6-summits.hears: The melody's summits: its A6 (and the F#6/G6 around it) struck hardest, v >= 95: 77.3, 90.6, 114.9 s, then 160.4 and 184.6 s. The moments the tune peaks.
a6-summits.rule: theme-a and theme-b notes >= F#6 with velocity >= 95

theme-a-p2.hears: Phrase 2 of theme-a (bars 48-51, four bars, about 6.9 s): the answer in long notes: F#5, D5, C#5, A5, F#5.

theme-a-p3.hears: Phrase 3 of theme-a (bars 52-55, four bars, about 6.9 s): the opening again, softer as it falls: F#6 A6 G6 F#6 C#6 B5 C#6 A5 F#5.

theme-a-p4.hears: Phrase 4 of theme-a (bars 56-59, four bars, about 6.9 s): its answer, closing on E5-G5-A5.

theme-a-p5.hears: Phrase 5 of theme-a (bars 60-63, four bars, about 6.9 s): second phrase: A5 C6 E6 | D6 B5 D6 | C6 B5.

theme-a-p6.hears: Phrase 6 of theme-a (bars 64-67, four bars, about 6.9 s): D6, then the climb F6 G6 A6 (114.2 s) and C6 D6.

theme-a-p7.hears: Phrase 7 of theme-a (bars 68-71, four bars, about 6.9 s): E6 D6 B5 D6 ... G6 G5: turning home.

theme-a-p8.hears: Phrase 8 of theme-a (bars 72-75, four bars, about 6.9 s): F#6 F#5 B5 | A5 B5 C#6 | D6 E6 C#6 | A5 ... F#5: the last line before the cadence.

cadence-approach.hears: The steps into each cadence: E2 under F#5 (131.6), B2-D5 (132.1), E minor (132.7), and the same at 200.8, 201.4 and 201.9 s. Three rising strokes before the blow.
cadence-approach.rule: pack clusters in 131.4-133.2 and 200.7-202.45 s with loudest >= 65; lowest, highest and loudest of each

cadence-blows.hears: The two ff endings of the theme, each a pair of held blocks: C major over A (133.3 s, v 97) then D major, the whole keyboard (135.0 s, v 92, rings 3.5 s); again 202.5 s (v 101) and 204.2 s (v 97, rings 3 s). The only real blows in the piece.
cadence-blows.rule: every pack note of the clusters at 133.27, 134.99, 202.50 and 204.22 s

theme-b.hears: The melody again, an octave higher at first (F#6 A6 G6 F#6 at 159.8 s), one statement of the first phrase, then the second phrase (173.1 s) with its F6-G6-A6 climb at 183.5 s, down to the cadence.
theme-b.rule: as theme-a, in 159.7-202.45 s, v >= 66 (the tick loop shares the register here: its off-beat strokes are left out by the beat rule, its Eb/Ab by the pitch rule)

theme-b-p1.hears: Phrase 1 of theme-b (bars 92-95, four bars, about 6.9 s): F#6 A6 G6 F#6 C#6 | D5 C#6: the opening an octave up.

theme-b-p2.hears: Phrase 2 of theme-b (bars 96-99, four bars, about 6.9 s): its answer, A6 C#6 ... F#6 A6 (held 3.3 s at 169.6 s) ... D6.

theme-b-p3.hears: Phrase 3 of theme-b (bars 100-103, four bars, about 6.9 s): second phrase: A6 B6 ... A5 B6 A6 D6 | B5 D6 C6.

theme-b-p4.hears: Phrase 4 of theme-b (bars 104-107, four bars, about 6.9 s): D6 A6 A6 A6, the climb F6 G6 A6 (183.5 s), C6.

theme-b-p5.hears: Phrase 5 of theme-b (bars 108-111, four bars, about 6.9 s): E6 D6 B5 D6 | A6 G6 B6.

theme-b-p6.hears: Phrase 6 of theme-b (bars 112-115, four bars, about 6.9 s): F#6 A6 B5 A5 ... D6 C#6 D6 ... B6: into the cadence.

drum-fill.hears: The drum fill that launches the groove after the second ring-out (snare-snare-tom-tom-kick 207.09-207.69 s), and the tom run 211.15-212.88 s (eight strokes on one tom).
drum-fill.rule: snare, toms, kick and crash notes in 207-207.8 s and toms in 211-213 s

groove-bass.hears: The groove's bass line, which the transcription misses entirely (no pack note below midi 50 after 205 s): a walking line around G2-E2-D2-F#2 over the vamp, then a pedal near E2 under the closing song. From the audio: pitch approximate (pyin, octave-folded), about 1.4 notes a second.
groove-bass.rule: audio-picks.json bass rows in 207.65-285.6 s (lowpass 180 Hz onsets with pyin pitch, kicks without a held pitch left out); octave slips folded to the neighbours' median; velocity -40 dB -> 45, -20 dB -> 105

backbeat.hears: The groove's kick and snare together (no cymbals): the breakbeat's skeleton, 207.7-285.6 s.
backbeat.rule: kick and snare notes in 207.7-285.6 s

groove-comp.hears: The piano's comping in the groove: the vamp chord on beat 2 of each bar (B-D-F# / A-C#-F#, later Em, Am, F), now short and punchy over the breakbeat (v 60-90).
groove-comp.rule: pack clusters on beat 2 (+-0.16 s) in 207.7-275.2 s with >= 3 notes in midi 45-80; lowest, highest and loudest of each

solo-line.hears: The piano improvising over the groove, its top line: short phrases from 213.5 s, sixteenth-note runs in the A5 octave from 235.4 s, climbing to F6-A6 with blue notes (Eb, F, Ab) from 252.7 s. Fast, light, many notes (0.05-0.5 s).
solo-line.rule: skyline of pack notes >= A4 not in groove-comp chords, minDur 0.05, hold 0.4, in 213.4-275.2 s

solo-accents.hears: The solo's hardest notes (v >= 92): the accents a listener taps, about one a bar.

solo-runs.hears: Only the runs of the solo: chains of five or more notes in sixteenths (0.14 s apart), mostly 236-274 s. The busiest strand of the piece.
solo-runs.rule: solo-line notes in chains of >= 5, each < 0.2 s after the previous

lead-descent.hears: The groove's closing song: a slow lead line falling from G6 (275.2 s) through F6-G6-F6, B5-C6, F6-E6-D6 (279.8-281 s), C6, Eb6-D6 to A5 (284.4 s) over F major and A minor. Long notes (0.5-1.7 s), loud (v 79-100). YourMT3 hears part of it as a lead voice.
lead-descent.rule: voiced-out pack notes >= B4 in 275.1-285.5 s, held >= 0.28 s, v >= 75

closing-hits.hears: The last three strokes of the band: C major (285.6 s, v 92), C-E-G (286.2 s, v 90) and the A4-D5 hit (287.3 s, v 108, the loudest note of the song) before the echoes.
closing-hits.rule: pack clusters in 285.5-287.6 s with loudest >= 85; every note

echo-tail.hears: The tail: D4 repeated in sixteenths (a delay) fading out with A3 and D3, -13 to -26 dB, the mix gone by 292 s.
